focus: Can a flat team use HyperIdle to build HyperIdle + other similar-stack apps? (self-host + multi-project)
verdict: self-host: NO (loop never closes) · multi-project: NO (single-global at every layer that matters)
method: 11 Explore lanes (full prod code + 205 docs + live app) -> 3 reviewer agents -> consolidated. 120 findings (15 blocker / 41 major / 64 minor).
consolidated_blockers_dep_ordered: 1. Wire thinking backend + zero-config boot (credential prompt + auto-migrate). Root cause; cheapest, largest radius.
3. Build the code/output substrate (project->repo binding, clone into sandbox, code-artifact record, local-git tool, writeback). Generalize beyond code.
4. Real review generation + merge AL7 (reviews table + POST + task/artifact/bet factories; review OUTPUTS not diffs; verdict surface already real).
5. Make 'project' first-class: reconcile 3 disjoint scope keys (teamId/productId/scopeId), team-scope promotion, per-project cost/sandbox/git/connections, project picker.
6. Outbound connectivity AN2/AN3 (outbound MCP client + broker; scope connections per project).
